title: Mystic Anvil Forge
description: A skeletal figure with crossed arms sits on a glowing purple crystal atop a large black anvil. The anvil rests in the center of a swirling purple vortex encircled by a glowing golden ring inscribed with runes, with floating books, moths, and a smoking rose above.
prompt: A skeletal figure wearing ornate gauntlets sits with arms crossed atop a large glowing purple crystal which rests on a massive black iron anvil with glowing orange cracks. The anvil is centered within a swirling cosmic vortex of deep purple and blue, encircled by a large golden ring covered in glowing runes. A smoking white rose hangs from the top of the ring. Books, moths, and magical artifacts float around the scene against an aurora-like background, dark fantasy style, intricate details, atmospheric lighting
